title: rungia latior var. hirsuta
intro: Rungia latior var. hirsuta, commonly known as Hairy Rungia, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. Hairy Rungia has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Ayurvedic and Unani systems, for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hairy Rungia include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and provide relief from digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents present in Hairy Rungia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
